newsitem.title: UK: UK utilities down after massive Labour victory.
newsitem.headline: UK utilities down after massive Labour victory.

text.p: Utilities stocks fell in early trading on Friday after Labour won a massive landslide victory on windfall tax and regulatory fears.
The mark-down will be short-lived, however with no real selling pressure keeping prices down, they said.
"If the initial reaction is a mark-down of that extent it won't be generated by real selling pressure and prices will come back pretty quickly," said Daiwa analyst, Andrew Stone.
Severn Trent Plc fell 6p to 750p, National Power Plc fell 5p to 527-1/2p, Thames Water Plc fell 7p to 672-1/2p and National Grid Plc fell 1-1/2p to 223p.
